defaults.description: Suggested values the user can change. Same keys as the enforced settings.

shiftHours.description: Length of a normal work day from clock-in to going home, including breaks (hours).

breakAllowanceMinutes.description: Break time already included in the shift. Paid hours per day = shift length minus this.

monthlyTargetHours.description: Hours required per month when targetMode is "fixed".

targetMode.description: "fixed" = monthlyTargetHours every month; "workdays" = work days in the month x paid hours per day.

leaveReducesTarget.description: Annual leave, sick days and public holidays on work days lower the month target by one day of paid hours.

workDays.description: Days of the week with a normal shift (0 = Sunday ... 6 = Saturday). Other days only count standby call-outs.

usualStart.description: Usual start time (HH:MM). The clock-in reminder starts up to two hours before it.

breakTypes.description: Break buttons: { id, label, icon, paid }. Unpaid breaks are taken off worked time.

displayName.description: Name attached to shared records when a team backend is linked.

standbyEnabled.description: Show the standby rotation and call-out log.

standbyAnchor.description: First day (YYYY-MM-DD) of any one of your standby periods. The rotation repeats from it.

standbyEveryWeeks.description: Weeks between the start of one standby period and the next (usually the number of people on the rota).

calloutsCountTowardMonth.description: Count standby call-out and ticket time towards the monthly hours.

leaveWarningMinutes.description: Notify this many minutes before the shift is complete (0 = off).

notifyShiftDone.description: Notify when the shift is complete.

breakReminderMinutes.description: Notify when a break runs longer than this (0 = off).

clockInPrompt.description: "off", "remind" (notification when the laptop is first used on a work day) or "auto" (clock in automatically then).

forgotClockOutHours.description: Remind if still clocked in this many hours after the shift ended (0 = off).

standbyReminderDays.description: Notify this many days before a standby period starts (0 = off).

badge.description: Toolbar badge: "remaining" (time to go home), "worked", "status" or "off".

trackActivity.description: Record how many minutes the laptop is actively used per day (minutes only, nothing about what was used).

idleMinutes.description: Minutes without keyboard or mouse input before the laptop counts as idle.

brand.description: Enforced brand kit fields (locked in Settings -> Branding).

connection.description: Optional shared-data backend. type: none | webhook | rest | supabase.
